Se você gosta de The Binding of Isaac mas acha que ele tem cores demais e trauma infantil de menos, Razenroth é a solução. É um roguelike que mistura a estética suja de Diablo com a punição gratuita de um indie de 2015.

Arte: Desenhos à mão que parecem saídos de um rascunho descartado do Lovecraft. É sombrio, detalhado e envelheceu surpreendentemente bem.

Gameplay: O combate é lento e deliberado. Não espere a fluidez de um Hades; aqui você luta contra os monstros e contra a própria inércia do personagem.

Progressão: O sistema de itens é vasto o suficiente para te deixar confuso e a progressão permanente é o que impede você de desinstalar o jogo após a décima morte seguida para um boss mal-intencionado.

Veredito: Um jogo sólido, honesto e barato. Perfeito para quem quer passar raiva em um cenário gótico sem precisar pagar caro por um Souls-like.

Nota: 7.5/10 — Morri de novo, mas vou mais uma.

Score: 2/5

[b]The Good[/b]
1. Audio/music/SFX
2. Movement is smooth, and controls are responsive.
3. Environmental/weather effects are mostly good, with some of the environment being unclear that it is impassible terrain or being intuitive that it is blocking the player's vision.
4. Balanced difficulty.

[b]The Bad[/b]
1. Gameplay got boring and repetitive in less than an hour, and there is almost no narrative/dialogue/story.
2. Not enough variation in enemy designs, move-sets/attacks, and strategies.
3. Most mechanics are not explained effectively, which fits/reinforces the narrative somewhat but was overall a negative.
4. Subpar writing. No explanation for why the main character has magical abilities. Introduction feels forced/lazy.
5. Visuals/art direction isn't great.

I am 32 years old.

My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and we adopted our son together. Both are now 4 years old.

When we were going through our separation, I felt lost and unhappy. I was self-destructive. One day, I was so angry with everything spiraling out of control that I punched a concrete wall in a moment of overwhelming emotion. This resulted in breaking my fifth metacarpal in my right hand—the hand I worked with, played games with, and used to carry my children to bed—the hand I desperately needed to ensure I could continue providing.

Upon learning the severity of the self-inflicted damage, I became almost suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man, with no history of depression or anxiety. I had never experienced anger outbursts, nor was I the type to break down and cry, but I was in a tough situation that truly prevented me from seeing the light on the other side.

With nothing better to do, I looked for a game I could play WITH ONE HAND while recovering. Somehow, I stumbled upon this game and read some of the comments. I decided it was worth a try... I must admit I didn't beat the game, nor did I play as much as some of you. In fact, I may have played this game for only a day or two. That being said, after doing so, I had a new joy and hope for life. I managed to leave behind the pain and suffering that had been thrust upon me. I could experience the joy and happiness of other people. I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ minutes listening to this music, long enough to realize that I would be okay.

After realizing this, I turned off the game and went back to work. My hand hurt a lot, but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so sorry for myself and became the father I needed to be at that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving like.

Today, I am close friends with the mother of my children. We don't fight, argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents and friends.

Now I have 3 children. My third child is, wait, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my separation, and we just unexpectedly stumbled into each other's lives. We have been dating for a year and are very happy together.

Moral of the story: you never know what life has in store for you, and if I had given up when all odds were against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

Thank you.

This is a game which has a cheap price but is not inferior at all. The game has content and fun that are not commensurate with its price, which surprised me heavily. It has the traditional gameplay of 'rogue - like', with a overlooking perspective. It's a bit difficult for beginners, but once you get the hang of it, the game becomes relatively easy. For example, you can use the various pillars in the game that cannot be shot through to avoid the attacks of small minions, and then playfully kill them. Of course, as a 'rogue - like' game, luck is also very very important. If you can't get powerful items all the time, it will become very difficult to fight against the final boss in the later stage. A very powerful item - The golden apple is very useful, especially on very hard difficulty level.
Completing different tasks in the game can unlock several different characters, and different characters have different passive skills, but I think the gap between the characters is not particularly big. Since there are a lot of random items in the game, a better collocation will make you stronger. Generally speaking, the more important attributes are % damage reduction, % critical attack damage and % critical attack chance. Of course, the basic magic damage and skill magic damage are also very important. Although there are many options for character attributes to add points, but most attributes do not feel very practical. I choose to add % critical attack damage to all, and then try to use equipment to stack % critical attack chance. There are not many more practical character skills. This depends on everyone's preferences, and it is mainly based on offense. I generally choose weapons with fast attack speed, so that it is easier to trigger more character passive skills. The black crystal in the game can be used to upgrade various functions of the hut. The more useful ones are a random magic item at the beginning of the game and a random BUFF every 90 seconds. So it's better to turn on all the hut functions as soon as possible. You can choose to kill BOSS quickly in low difficulty games to get a lot of black crystals. If you think the very hard difficulty is difficult to pass, you can consider saving a lot of black crystals in one go, then exchange the black crystals for gold coins in a game which has gambling merchant, and then gamble a lot of items, such a super powerful character was born! There is no suspense at the end of the game. You will easily defeat the final boss. Of course the golden apple + gambling merchant will be better.
Overall, although this game is cheap, the content far exceeds its price, it is cost-effective. It also brought me a lot of joy, and if you don't think about making achievements, it'll keep you playing for at least 10 hours. If you can live with its seemingly bad graphics, I recommend you give it a try. To be honest, I have quite a few games from this developer, and I believe most of their works can reach this level. Thanks to the developers for their good works.

《Razenroth》是一款深受玩家喜爱的 roguelike 动作冒险游戏，它凭借其丰富的随机元素、深度的战斗系统以及引人入胜的暗黑风格，成功在同类游戏中脱颖而出，为玩家带来了一场紧张刺激且充满未知挑战的冒险之旅。

游戏的一大亮点便是其高度随机生成的关卡设计。每次玩家踏入Razenroth的世界，都会面临全新的地宫布局和怪物配置，这意味着即使在同一章节反复挑战，也能体验到迥然不同的游戏过程。这种不确定性为游戏注入了无穷的生命力，激发了玩家不断探索和挑战的欲望。

战斗系统方面做得相当扎实且富有深度。游戏提供了大量的武器、装备和魔法供玩家选择和搭配，每一种组合都能衍生出独特的战斗风格。此外游戏中还融入了角色培养元素，通过击败敌人和解开谜题来获取经验和能力提升，玩家可以根据自身喜好打造出独一无二的英雄角色。

在视觉与音效方面营造了一种浓郁的暗黑奇幻氛围。阴郁的地下城、恐怖的怪物造型以及紧张激昂的背景音乐，共同构筑了一部引人入胜的冒险史诗。尽管画面风格并非顶级3A大作级别，但其独特的艺术风格和精细的场景描绘足以彰显出开发团队的匠心独运。

另外游戏中的天气系统和动态事件为游戏增添了更多变数和挑战，如突然袭来的暴风雪或突兀出现的神秘商人，都让玩家的冒险之路变得更加丰富多彩。

总的来说，这是一款将roguelike元素与动作冒险完美结合的游戏，它以其独特的游戏体验、丰富的随机性和深度的策略性赢得了玩家的赞誉。虽然在某些方面可能还存在些许瑕疵，但瑕不掩瑜，它依然是一款值得玩家投入时间、精力去探索和挑战的优秀作品。对于喜欢roguelike和动作冒险游戏的玩家，无疑是不容错过的选择。
